paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
notes: Paper presents limits on oscillating neutron EDM (dn ~ few x10^-25 e.cm amplitude from Fig.2), interpreted as axion-gluon coupling CG/fa (Fig.4 top) and axion-nucleon coupling CN/fa (Fig.4 bottom). The primary exclusion plot y-axes are CG/fa and CN/fa (GeV^-1), not d_n directly, which complicates coupling-type assignment. The oscillating EDM (AxionEDM) values are approximate estimates from Fig.2 (~3-4 x10^-25 e.cm). Mass range 1e-24 to 1e-17 eV (freq converted via m=4.136e-15*f). Note: the paper could equally be classified under AxionNeutron (axion-wind) or as f_a-plane constraints; ambiguity lowers confidence.
